name: freshdesk-ticket-helper
description: Secure Electron desktop helper for Freshdesk tickets and local AI context sanitization

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @fth/protocol && npm run dev -w @fth/desktop
scripts.build: npm run build -w @fth/protocol && npm run build -w @fth/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fth/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @fth/desktop
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run pack -w @fth/desktop
